methodology.scope: A deliberately diverse public corpus spanning hospitality, editorial, luxury, agencies, SaaS, ecommerce, legal, finance, healthcare, data storytelling and spatial experiments.
methodology.candidateMeaning: Every hero and motion description is a research hypothesis, not a verified claim about the current live implementation.
methodology.reachabilityMethod: A redirect-following HTTP probe was run on 2026-07-15; it was not a browser render, interaction test or rights review.
methodology.promotionRule: A candidate may become scanned only after documented Playwright evidence across desktop, mobile and reduced-motion states plus completed human visual review; promotion additionally requires a reusable mechanic, original reconstruction guidance and an explicit publication-rights classification.

rightsPolicy.captureRule: Raw third-party captures remain private unless publication rights are documented; public evidence uses links, permitted excerpts or original recreations.
rightsPolicy.implementationRule: Reproduce the mechanic with original code and licensed or original assets; never present copied third-party implementation or assets as repository-owned work.
